ctx.x: George Uge. He was a drummer. He used to come to my house and pick me up. My mother would let me go. And, we used to, I used to play certain parties and dances for him. During the summertime, I was out to Tuxedo Junction. I played a whole summer while school was at recess. And then, I got a lot of opportunities to do those things with those musicians. I didn't get too much other training, you know. Just myself.
Right. And, how old were you when you were doing this kind of jobbing?
